requestedBehavior: A jammed droid shows the approved no-repair-2 icon beside its HP exactly while BattleSimulation reports the repair-jammer status.

baseline.worktree: dirty with unrelated arena, UI, localization, and combat changes; this slice is restricted to BattleUnitView, BattleUnitPresenter, BattleSceneController, a focused view test, and Rex evidence.
baseline.graph: No code-review-graph MCP tool is available in this agent session, so targeted source inspection and rg are the fallback.

reuseLadder.reason: The approved combat specification explicitly requires the status icon beside HP.
BattleUnitView already owns lazy child SpriteRenderer creation and state toggling for freeze, poison, lava, and electro effects.
The approved texture is already in the established UI Resources family and existing runtime views use Unity sprite renderers.

reuseLadder.option: Add a package or UI framework
reuseLadder.reason: No dependency is needed for a single world-space status sprite.

reuseLadder.option: Call the view directly from the controller
reuseLadder.reason: BattleUnitPresenter already encapsulates state-to-view presentation, so it should expose a narrow status forwarding method.

reuseLadder.option: Add one repair-jammer sprite renderer and a presenter forwarding method
reuseLadder.reason: This is the smallest complete extension: the controller queries the existing simulation status during RefreshUnitViews, presenter forwards it, and the view owns only its visual child.
